data.title: Russia glosses over dark Soviet past in reinvented museum
data.description: MOSCOW - In a Moscow museum that once housed evidence of Stalin-era repression, serene family scenes flickered on a screen as a narrator hailed the tranquility of pre-World War II life in the Soviet Union.

data.title: Man held for ‘renting’ ID cards to underage clubgoers
data.description: KHON KAEN - Police have arrested a 19-year-old man accused of renting out national ID cards to underage youths seeking entry to entertainment venues in Khon Kaen, charging 100 baht per card.

data.title: PROUD wins four major awards, reinforcing its ‘Luxury Wellness Developer’ brand
data.description: At a time when the definition of “Luxury Living” is no longer limited to location, materials or a project’s image, but is shifting towards the long-term design of a better life, “Wellness” is becoming one of the key standards of modern living. It is also a direction that Proud Real Estate Public Company Limited, or PROUD, has consistently placed at the core of its brand.

data.title: Natthaphong says government’s flood response has failed
data.description: People’s Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has called on the government to do more to help local administrative bodies recover from the floods, saying the performance so far has not been good.

data.title: Nasa rover takes striking image of dawn's early light on Mars
data.description: WASHINGTON — The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (Nasa) has released a striking image of dawn ‌on the Martian surface taken by its Curiosity rover, showing sunlight bathing jagged crags formed billions of years ago as the car-sized vehicle continues to explore Earth's planetary neighbour.

data.title: Mayor of opposition stronghold Izmir defects to Erdogan party
data.description: ANKARA - The mayor of Izmir, Turkey's third city and an opposition stronghold, on Wednesday defected to the ruling AKP, in a huge symbolic victory for Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

data.title: 'Digger' asks why you are sitting in that cinema seat
data.description: Digger (2026) is a self-conscious climate-change satire that’s difficult to discuss without risking spoilers. What I can say is that, despite its box-office failure, it deserves to be seen on the big screen. This American black comedy knows exactly what kind of film it is, offering a full cinematic experience: visual spectacle and a meta-narrative that may leave you questioning yourself as you sit in your seat.

data.title: Insignia brings ‘A Taste of Insignia’ to Thailand, marking market entry with Siam Piwat
data.description: BANGKOK, THAILAND , 5 October 2026 — Insignia, a global leader in bespoke lifestyle management and ultra-premium payment solutions, today marks its entry into Thailand with A Taste of Insignia, an exclusive experience in Bangkok presented as part of Unlock the World of Insignia. Created as an intimate introduction to the world of Insignia. The experience brings together the brand’s bespoke lifestyle management services, ultra-premium financial solutions, and carefully curated global network, introducing its philosophy of personalised access and possibility to Thailand for the first time.

data.title: Rubio in Greece to warn against ‘decline’ of Western civilisation
data.description: ATHENS - US Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in Athens on Wednesday ahead of a “strategic dialogue” with the NATO member on regional and energy security, the State Department said.

data.title: Yemen's Houthis claim new attacks on Saudi airports
data.description: RIYADH - The Houthis claimed a flurry of attacks on Saudi targets on Wednesday including firing a ballistic missile at Riyadh airport, as the group battles for territory in Yemen against government forces supported by the kingdom.

data.title: France suspends stun grenade use at student protests
data.description: PARIS - France has suspended the use of stun grenades by police at student-led demonstrations, the interior minister said Wednesday, as allegations of police brutality mounted after days of sometimes violent demonstrations across the country.

data.title: Second incinerator key to solving Phuket’s waste problem
data.description: PHUKET - Authorities in this southern island province are seeking a land plot to build a second incinerator to handle a growing amount of garbage.

data.title: Megabangna hosts haunted uni for Halloween
data.description: Megabangna Shopping Centre, in collaboration with various partners, is turning up the terror with “Mega Halloween 2026: Haunted University” from Oct 9 to Nov 1 at Mega Plaza, Megabangna Shopping Centre.

data.title: ONE Championship: Yu Yau Pui eyes Stamp Fairtex fight after finding herself again
data.description: Hong Kong’s Yu Yau Pui would welcome a fight with Thai star Stamp Fairtex as she looks to climb ONE Championship’s atomweight Muay Thai rankings with renewed self-belief after beating Britain’s Marie McManamon.

data.title: ONE Championship: Luke Lessei enters title picture as Carrillo eyes first defence
data.description: Luke Lessei has strengthened his case to challenge Nico Carrillo in his first defence of the undisputed featherweight Muay Thai title, with back-to-back wins arriving as the ONE Championship king targets December.

data.title: Micron workers at Taiwan plant vote in favour of strike
data.description: TAIPEI - Hundreds of workers at a Micron Technology plant in Taiwan have voted to strike, their union said Wednesday, after talks with the US memory chip giant over bonus reforms collapsed.

data.title: Aids hospice embezzlers sentenced to hundreds of years
data.description: Former monk and aide also ordered to return B300 million to Wat Phrabat Namphu

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor PLC Earns Recognition for Financial Education at ESGBusiness Awards 2026
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , won the Social Inclusion and Equal Opportunities Award - Thailand at the ESGBusiness Awards 2026 . The award recognizes the organization's outstanding performance in driving equality and fostering social inclusion through the "Financial Knowledge to Communities for Life Rolls Forward" project, which has been operating continuously for over a decade. This reflects the company's intention to elevate people's quality of life through creating financial knowledge opportunities, aiming to promote sustainably better lives for people in society.

data.title: Myanmar leader lands in Malaysia for migrant return talks
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Myanmar's leader landed for his first visit to Malaysia on Wednesday, since taking power in a 2021 coup, as Kuala Lumpur seeks his cooperation to return thousands of migrants.

data.title: Bangkok Central Kitchen brings healthy meals to 1500 students
data.description: "Bangkok, City for Better Health" launched a "Central Kitchen" at Wat Don School, enabling the preparation of nutritious meals for almost 1,500 students across seven schools in the Sathon and Bang Rak districts.
